landing.heroSubhead: Stop searching. Start knowing. Deploy specialized AI assistants that turn your scattered company data into instant, verified answers. Upload your files, ask a question, and get the exact truth.
landing.sampleUserQuery: What is our policy on API rate limits?
landing.sampleAssistantReply: Standard tier rate limits allow 120 requests/minute with burst capacity up to 200. Enterprise tiers provide dedicated quota pools.
landing.feature1Desc: Need a direct conclusion? Ask a complex question and let the AI synthesize a complete, easy-to-read response from thousands of documents. It reads the heavy manuals and contracts so you don't have to.
landing.feature2Desc: Just looking for the raw source? Switch to deep search mode. Instantly retrieve the exact paragraphs, clauses, or pages matching the intent of your query. It’s like Ctrl+F, but for the actual meaning of your words.
landing.feature3Desc: Whether you use chat or search, every single output is strictly anchored to your proprietary data. Never guess if the AI is making things up—every response includes a direct citation to the exact document. Pure facts, completely isolated.
